author: musho7-dev
subject: Raise mid/late game prices and sort the garage by price
body:
Top cars cost 8,000-15,000, x4/x5 maps cost 4,000-6,000, and premium
paints and rims cost more. The upgrade price multiplier is capped at 2x.
Cars and maps are listed cheapest first. The Daily Challenge keeps its
old map rotation, so today's daily map doesn't change. The "Only X
coins to unlock" hint now shows commas.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
